public_bar: Trace each substantive behavioral assertion to exact pinned evidence; separate intent, observed implementation and unexecuted claims.
Reconcile all 424 assigned sources by meaningful need and depth without treating a census as understanding.
Close the specific leaf-reading gaps, capture provenance and independently review every required artifact.
Use only accepted required predecessors for L2, then L3, then L4.
Publish/import/read/consumer/maintenance evidence is separate from semantic acceptance; unknown usage stays UNKNOWN.

cases.question: Precisamos acrescentar uma ferramenta tipada e sob demanda, com efeito de escrita. Onde registrar e validar, onde autorizar e o que deve acontecer quando o registro muda durante uma chamada já materializada?
expected: Canonical Tool.make with input/output schemas; process ApplicationTools or Location Tools registration according to placement.
Catalog/on-demand filtering does not authorize execution; leaf captures permission service and canonical source identity.
Captured registration identity must not silently dispatch replaced tool; stale settlement refusal, scope disposal reveals previous registration.
critical_errors: Replaced tool silently runs under stale definition

cases.question: Um plugin fornece JSON com Session, agente e call ID e pede capacidade nativa. Esses IDs bastam? Como reconhecer os limites da autorização e da persistência?
expected: Host-issued private context frame, matching invocation and placement is required; model JSON is not authority.
Persisted live tool part and current permission validation belongs to CapabilityPolicy; root frame alone is insufficient.
Recheck after approval and at governed commit; restrictions cannot be widened by later allows.
critical_errors: Trust model-supplied IDs as issued authority
Extend capability guarantees to all arbitrary plugins

cases.question: Uma mudança na declaração/política de ferramenta e outra no contrato de plugin/capacidade foram propostas. Quais artefatos precisam ser reavaliados e como evitar reutilizar binding desatualizado preservando os independentes?
expected: Separate catalog declaration from leaf permission and host capability authorization; follow exact source/recipe/build edges, not all navigation links.
Source, policy, body, recipe or authority changes create new binding candidate; old approval cannot bind it.
Identify unchanged source/recipe/results for reuse; preserve old evidence and distinguish source impact from unobserved operation.
critical_errors: Reuse runtime binding across changed candidate or source root
Invent runtime input versions from transport hashes

cases.question: Uma instalação de plugin falha após registrar contribuições, um OAuth fica pendente e uma mutação MCP é interrompida. Como orientar diagnóstico e recuperação sem criar garantias inexistentes?
expected: Scoped activation cleanup and state rematerialization, explicit boundaries of batch rollback/cycle detection.
OAuth attempt in-memory with lifetime/expiry; no claim of crash-resumable flow.
Distinguish SDK MCP from native bounded transport; interrupted ambiguous mutation cannot be asserted not executed; preserve outcome_unknown where implemented.
critical_errors: DELETE/abort proves remote mutation did not execute

cases.question: Podemos garantir que qualquer plugin, ferramenta ou capacidade está sempre sandboxed, validado localmente e protegido em todos os sistemas operacionais?
expected: Refuse universal claim; mandatory wrapper is not unconditional confinement; dynamic schemas not automatically local validation.
Different surfaces own permission; observed implementation/tests as source do not establish executed cross-platform protection.
Give exact evidence needed and authorized owner without weakening guards.
critical_errors: Count unexecuted source tests as runtime proof

cases.question: Distingua perda de captura do produtor, truncamento genérico e projeção Lean; qual evidência mantém o original e quais limites impedem prometer sua recuperação integral?
expected: Each loss/bound/projection boundary separately explained, original capture may already be incomplete.
Attestation/provenance controls and actual retention/recall constraints cited; no universal reconstructability.

cases.question: Como localizar a autoridade real de uma chamada antes de decidir se catálogo, aprovação ou contexto permite um efeito?
expected: Map path-specific decision boundaries and required evidence; avoid equivalence between visibility and authority.

cases.question: Qual é a interface de responsabilidade de host/plugins/capacidades para a necessidade N01 de S1-05?
expected: Concrete host/plugin authority and lifecycle contract, cross-scope implementation citations distinguished from accepted dependent artifacts; named complement to S1-05.

maintenance.question: Change tool declaration/policy input in isolated observed source; inspect impact and rejection of old binding; restore exact bytes and show compatible reuse.
expected: Affected tools lineage becomes stale or refused through actual Atlas observation/read; independent extensions evidence remains compatible if inputs unchanged; restore is not invented new approval.

maintenance.question: Change plugin/capability contract input in isolated source; verify scope independence and stale binding rejection.
expected: Affected extension/capability downstream dependency graph is explicit; unchanged unrelated scope/result preserved; no approval transferred to changed candidate.

limitations: Expected implementation details require pinned decisive support, never treating oracle text as source.
No case grants product-test, policy, credential or external-service permission.
